# q3-dro Data Plan

Sets the decomposition fields (`DecompositionScope`, `CustomDecompositionScope`,
`FulfillmentQtyCalcMethod`) on the 78 Q3 products. It loads in `prepare_dro` step 3 or 4
(`insert_q3_dro_data_scratch` / `insert_q3_dro_data_prod`) when `dro` and `q3` are on and
`qb` is off.

## Notes

- **Source:** the `sdb39-q3` source org (2026-11-03). 32 of its 78 products have a
  `DecompositionScope`, all `OrderLineItem`. It has **no fulfillment design**: 0 step
  groups, steps, dependencies, scenarios, workspaces, decomposition rules, fallout or
  jeopardy rules. So this plan ships none, and a Q3 org gets no DRO fulfillment plans.
  qb-dro's design can't be reused, because its rules and scenarios reference QB SKUs.
- **Replaced plan (todo 210):** the plan used to declare 16 more objects, all with
  header-only CSVs, which loaded nothing. `FulfillmentWorkspaceItem` also carried
  `deleteOldData: true`, so a load would have deleted an org's existing workspace items and
  inserted none. `Product2.csv` was unchanged: all 78 rows match the source by name.
- **Product2 match:** the Update matches on `StockKeepingUnit`, which q3-pcm sets
  on every Q3 product. Most source-org products have no SKU, and two share the product
  code `LPB001`, so compare against `sdb39-q3` by name, and extract from a built Q3 org.
